limitations: No statistically established native CPU, wakeup or memory gain from the idle runs.
Profiler callback counts are not native interrupt wakeups.
Incomplete captures are diagnostic only and excluded from comparisons.
Proxy phase exercises local stats/control, not upstream streaming or live model traffic.
No live agent issue work or larger-tab scaling is included.
